trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is no extra task behind it. It is single-player only, with no online trophy and no DLC requirement, so one playthrough is enough. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours; the long pole is 100% completion, not the story.
steps: Finish the story (S1) and the character finales (S3).
Clear the 100% Completion checklist (S7) — it is the last big gate.
Sweep the remaining collectibles, activities and crime trophies (S4–S6).
The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 show as earned.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is the first thing the game asks of you, and this trophy is automatic the moment it ends. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — just play the intro. PowerPyx lists it as an automatic story trophy that cannot be missed.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 ends on its own as you work through its missions — this is a pure progress trophy. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one missable thing in the whole game: the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy). PowerPyx warns that the first meditation, at Jason's house, is gone once Chapter 1 ends.
steps: Play through every Chapter 1 mission in order.
BEFORE the last Chapter 1 mission: do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (Positive Mental Attitude).
Finish the final Chapter 1 mission to close the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 closes automatically when its last mission ends. The name is masked with asterisks on PlayStation itself — that is how the game publishes it. Keep a manual save at the start and the end of the chapter, since there is no mission replay; PowerPyx recommends a save at each chapter boundary.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 2.
Play through the Chapter 2 missions in order.
Make a manual save at the end of Chapter 2, then move on.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 ends the same way as the others — finish its missions and the trophy is yours. By now the map is wide open, so it is a good moment to pick up side activities (races, stunts, WAiNK scans) between missions, since everything you do already counts toward the 100% checklist. PowerPyx notes that progress made during the story counts toward the checklist even before it becomes visible.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 3.
Play through the Chapter 3 missions in order.
Between missions, try side activities — they already count toward 100%.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the last full chapter before the finale, and it closes automatically on its final mission. Before the ending, make sure the character-finale strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are finished or at least started — they stay available in free-roam afterwards, but it is cleaner to clear them now. PowerPyx confirms every quest giver tied to a trophy comes back after the story.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.
Play through the Chapter 4 missions in order.
Clear any open character-finale strands before the final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The final story mission is the only gold trophy tied to the plot, and it unlocks the moment the mission ends. After it, the game returns you to free-roam and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, then Stats. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the end of the final mission — PowerPyx suggests a save at the start and end of every chapter.
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission.
Play the final mission to its end.
After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, to see the 100% Completion checklist.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission, so this trophy is automatic when the mission ends. It is one of the early hidden story trophies — its name gives away a mission title, which is why PlayStation hides it until earned. Just play the story in order and it will pop on its own.
steps: Play the story until the Breakfast Run mission appears.
Complete the Breakfast Run mission.
The trophy pops at the mission end screen.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission, and this trophy unlocks automatically when it is done. Heist missions are the big set-pieces of the story — there is no special requirement beyond finishing the mission itself. PowerPyx lists it as an automatic story trophy.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist mission appears.
Complete The Cartel Heist mission.
The trophy pops at the mission end screen.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission, and this trophy is automatic when it ends. Like the other mission trophies, it is hidden on PlayStation until earned because its name reveals a mission title. Play the story in order and it will unlock on its own.
steps: Play the story until the Child's Play mission appears.
Complete the Child's Play mission.
The trophy pops at the mission end screen.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission, and this trophy unlocks automatically when it is done. The stylised name (DWNFALL) is how PlayStation publishes it. There is no extra objective — finish the mission and the trophy follows.
steps: Play the story until the Headliners mission appears.
Complete the Headliners mission.
The trophy pops at the mission end screen.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission at the airport, and this trophy is automatic when it ends. It is also the mission that sets up the Catch Me If You Can trophy (an unscheduled departure at VCIA), so remember the airport layout — you will come back here for that one.
steps: Play the story until the VCIA Takedown mission appears.
Complete the VCIA Takedown mission.
The trophy pops at the mission end screen.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission, and this trophy unlocks automatically when it is done. It is the last of the named story-mission trophies before the finale, so once it pops you are close to the end of the plot. Play the story in order and it will unlock on its own.
steps: Play the story until the Operation Savage Glory mission appears.
Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission.
The trophy pops at the mission end screen.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last big gate before the platinum. The 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, only after the story ends. PowerPyx says it is closer to 60% true game completion — most side quests are not required, and collectibles are only partly required. You need 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 base vehicle models, and 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars. The only tasks that demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress, then Stats, to see the 100% Completion checklist.
Clear every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest — these need 100%.
Reach 70 of 80 Challenges (you may skip the hardest 10).
Scan 200 of 277 base vehicle models and study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars.
The trophy pops when the checklist hits 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count — jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps. You do not need all 397, so skip the ones that frustrate you and repeat the easy ones in different spots. Stunts are the biggest single grind in the activities set, so chip away at them between missions rather than leaving all 250 for the end. GameMapa reports 397 stunts in total, with 250 needed.
steps: Open the stunt list and pick a cluster of easy jumps near each other.
Land jumps, fly under bridges, and try Knife Flights and base jumps — each counts.
Repeat in new spots; only 250 of 397 are needed, so skip the hard ones.
Track the count here; the trophy pops at 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once — you only need one attempt at each, not a win. The nine are the game's side activities (races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, drone races, stunts, meditation, hunting and one more of the open-world pastimes). Dip into each early so you know which ones you enjoy; the rest of the activity trophies build on the same list. PowerPyx and KeenGamer both put the count at nine types.
steps: Open the activities list and note the 9 types.
Try each type once — an attempt counts, a win is not needed.
Tick each type off here as you try it.
The trophy pops when all 9 show as tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is one of the few tasks the 100% checklist also demands in full, so there is no shortcut — every range needs a gold. Use a steady weapon, take your time on the timed lanes, and redo a challenge immediately while the layout is fresh in your head. PowerPyx lists the count at 42 gold medals.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open its challenge list.
Earn a gold medal on each of the 42 challenges.
Redo a failed challenge at once while the layout is fresh.
The trophy pops at 42 golds.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are also one of the tasks the 100% checklist demands in full, so every location matters. Learn each course's tight corners on a practice run, then race to win — a win at each of the 14 spots is what counts, not a single fast time.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations across Leonida.
Practice a course once to learn its corners, then race to win.
Win at each of the 14 locations.
The trophy pops at 14 wins.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the word different matters, so repeating the same race does not count twice. Spread across the race types (street, off-road, boat, air) and pick the ones that suit your vehicle. Each new race you win ticks the count up by one; 20 distinct wins is the target.
steps: Open the race list and pick 20 different races.
Win each one — a repeat win on the same race does not count again.
Mix race types to suit your best vehicles.
The trophy pops at 20 distinct wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so this also ticks a box toward Master of None. Take the best rod and bait you can afford, watch the line tension, and do not rush the reel — Cal is beatable with patience rather than speed.
steps: Find Cal and accept his fishing challenge.
Use your best rod and bait.
Keep the line tension steady and reel patiently.
Beat Cal's catch to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish a single arcade game — any one will do. Arcade cabinets are scattered around Leonida's bars and arcades; sit down at one and play it through to the end. This is one of the quickest activity trophies and also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in a bar or arcade.
Start any arcade game.
Play it through to the end.
The trophy pops when the game completes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's mission strand ends with a final mission, and this trophy pops when it is done. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia. The quest givers tied to trophies come back after the story, so even if you finish the plot first, Andy's strand stays available in free-roam. PowerPyx notes the Lucia-only and Jason-only strands and that every trophy quest giver returns after the story.
steps: Play as Lucia and follow Andy's mission strand.
Complete each of Andy's missions in order.
Finish Andy's final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's mission strand ends with a final mission, and this trophy pops when it is done. The name is a joke about a boat, so expect water in the strand. Like the other character finales, it stays available in free-roam after the story, so there is no rush — but clearing it before the finale keeps the endgame tidy.
steps: Follow Kenton's mission strand to its end.
Complete each of Kenton's missions in order.
Finish Kenton's final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's mission strand ends with a final mission, and this trophy pops when it is done. The strand is built around riding, so keep a good bike handy. It stays available in free-roam after the story, like the other character finales, so you can finish it whenever it suits your route.
steps: Follow Billy's mission strand to its end.
Complete each of Billy's missions in order.
Finish Billy's final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map as you explore; each strand is a short chain with its own characters. Eight strands is the target, and the character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are separate trophies, so count only the stranger strands here. PowerPyx puts the cleanup of Strangers & Freaks in its final step, after the 100% checklist.
steps: Explore Leonida and note the stranger mission icons on the map.
Start a strand and finish all of its missions.
Repeat until 8 strands are complete.
The trophy pops at 8 strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's mission strand ends with a final mission, and this trophy pops when it is done. The strand is built around supply runs, so expect driving and delivery work. It stays available in free-roam after the story, like the other character finales.
steps: Follow Randy's mission strand to its end.
Complete each of Randy's missions in order.
Finish Randy's final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's mission strand ends with a final mission, and this trophy pops when it is done. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so play it as Jason. Like the other character finales, it stays available in free-roam after the story. PowerPyx notes the Jason-only strands (Tyrone and Bret) alongside the Lucia-only one (Andy).
steps: Play as Jason and follow Tyrone's mission strand.
Complete each of Tyrone's missions in order.
Finish Tyrone's final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY YOU CAN MISS. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and the first one is missable. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation. Complete that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1, or it is gone. The last meditation cannot be done until you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag this as the only possibly missable trophy in the game.
steps: CHAPTER 1 — after Down to Earth: find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony, and meditate. Do this BEFORE leaving Chapter 1.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can play as both characters, start the remaining spots.
Meditate at each of the 18 spots across Leonida.
The trophy pops at 18 spots. Keep a manual save at each chapter boundary as a safety net.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are also one of the tasks the 100% checklist demands in full, so this strand matters twice. Bret's strand is Jason-only. Track the animal with the hunting tools, take the shot cleanly, and bring the result back to Bret. PowerPyx notes Bret's quests among the full-completion tasks and the Jason-only strands.
steps: Play as Jason and pick up Bret's hunting strand.
Track the unique animal Bret asks for.
Hunt it and return to Bret.
The trophy pops when the hunt is handed in.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, and the 100% checklist asks for 15 complete sets in total — so this trophy is only the start of the card hunt. Pick three sets and finish them first, then keep collecting toward the 15 the checklist wants. KeenGamer reports 15 complete card sets for the 100% checklist.
steps: Find collectible cards around Leonida and note which set each belongs to.
Complete 3 full sets.
The trophy pops at 3 sets — then keep going toward the 15 the 100% checklist wants.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. WAiNK is the in-game camera/scan app, so point it at anything that looks like a landmark and scan it. The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and the checklist line up exactly. GameMapa describes the spots as landmarks, curiosities and sculptures.
steps: Open the WAiNK app on your phone.
Point it at landmarks, curiosities and sculptures and scan them.
Work through towns and the countryside — 100 spots is the target.
The trophy pops at 100 scanned locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and the 100% checklist only needs 70 of them — so you can skip the hardest 10 entirely. Pick the easy groups first and let the count build as you play; 50 is well within reach before you chase the 70. PowerPyx reports 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, with 70 needed for 100%.
steps: Open the challenges list (eight groups of ten).
Clear the easiest groups first.
Reach 50 completed challenges for this trophy.
Keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist — the hardest 10 can be skipped.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and escape. Build the wanted level with your partner present, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. A fast car and a quiet corner of the map make this much easier than fighting it out — the goal is to escape, not to win a shootout.
steps: Play with your partner beside you.
Raise your Wanted Level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and hide until the heat clears.
The trophy pops when the wanted level is gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your Wanted Level. The trick is the 'without losing' part — keep the wanted level the whole way through all three robberies, so do not let it clear between shops. Pick three shops close together, move fast, and keep your partner with you for all three.
steps: Pick three shops close together on the map.
Rob the first shop with your partner present to raise your Wanted Level.
Rob the second and third shops back-to-back, keeping the wanted level alive.
The trophy pops after the third robbery.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning vehicles with the WAiNK app counts toward this and toward the 100% checklist, which wants 200 of the 277 base vehicle models. Scan every new vehicle you see as you drive — it is the same habit that feeds the checklist, so doing it from the start saves a second sweep later. PowerPyx puts the checklist at 200 of 277 base models.
steps: Scan every new vehicle you see with the WAiNK app.
Drive through different districts — new models appear in new areas.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles for this trophy.
Keep scanning toward 200 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, and bring Adrenaline. Use an assault rifle for the range and rate of fire, trigger Combat Focus when five enemies are in view, and drop all five before it ends. GameMapa's tip is to buff focus first, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle.
steps: Buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home.
Bring Adrenaline and an assault rifle.
Find a fight with at least 5 enemies in view.
Trigger Combat Focus and drop all 5 before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (the airport). This is a stunt-style trophy — leave the airport in a way no flight plan covers, such as taking a plane without clearance. The airport is the same place as the VCIA Takedown mission, so you already know the layout; now use it for a getaway instead of a takedown.
steps: Go to VCIA (the airport).
Get to a plane on the runway.
Take off without clearance — an unscheduled departure.
The trophy pops once you are airborne and away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the tanks. Get into a Rhino tank and make something of it. Tanks draw heavy attention, so pick a quiet moment and a clear route before you climb in. The trophy is a one-off moment rather than a grind, so it is a good palate cleanser between the big counters.
steps: Find a Rhino tank.
Get in and drive it.
Do what the moment asks — the trophy pops from the tank itself.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a stealth robbery — go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again; a clean run is what counts, not a fast one.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and case it first.
Enter quietly and avoid cameras and staff sightlines.
Take the goods without being detected.
Leave clean — the trophy pops on a successful undetected robbery.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults are also one of the tasks the 100% checklist demands in full — KeenGamer reports 8 bank vault robberies for the checklist, so this trophy's 5 is a milestone on the way to 8. Plan each vault (entry, loot, exit) and escape cleanly; a failed escape does not count.
steps: Find a bank vault and plan entry and exit.
Rob the vault and escape cleanly.
Repeat at 5 different vaults.
The trophy pops at 5 — keep going to 8 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida, so wait for one on a quiet stretch, stop it, take the cash, and get away before the response arrives. A fast getaway car parked nearby turns a risky robbery into a clean one.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop the truck and take the cash.
Escape before the response arrives.
The trophy pops on a successful escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. This is the map-completion trophy, and it rewards simply driving and walking everywhere. Use the in-game map to spot the areas you have not visited yet, and sweep them district by district. It pairs naturally with the WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries, so do them on the same trips.
steps: Open the map and note the areas you have not visited.
Drive and walk through each unvisited area.
Sweep district by district — 52 areas is the target.
The trophy pops when the last area is explored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own operations, so you need one hit per gang — nine hits in total, one for each crew. KeenGamer reports 39 Gang Operations for the 100% checklist, so this trophy's 9 is the first pass; the checklist wants the full sweep afterwards.
steps: Find the illegal operations run by each of the 9 gangs.
Rob one operation per gang.
Tick each gang off here as you hit it.
The trophy pops at 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a quiet one-off moment — go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. PowerPyx lists its exact condition as still unconfirmed, so treat the description literally: a cocktail, with a view, on Ocean Beach. It is a good breather between the big grinds.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail at a beach bar.
Enjoy it with the view.
The trophy pops on the moment.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side — the classic GTA exit. PowerPyx lists its exact condition as still unconfirmed, so treat the description literally: a vehicle showroom, smashed through, in style.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Get in a car inside or drive one in.
Smash your way out through the glass.
The trophy pops on the exit.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. PowerPyx reads this one as stealing three valuables there — no guide says you actually bowl a game, despite the name. Go to the bowling alley, take three valuables, and leave. The name is a joke; the act is a quiet lift.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Take three valuables from inside.
Leave with all three.
The trophy pops on the third valuable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This is one of the five hidden trophies whose exact condition is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists it as unknown, so the description is all we have. It is tied to a partnership moment with your partner, so play the partner content and watch for a moment that fits the name. Treat it as a cleanup trophy for the final sweep.
steps: Play the partner content with Lucia or Jason.
Watch for a partnership moment with mass appeal.
The trophy pops on the moment — check it in the final sweep (S7).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — PlayStation tracks a count to 500. This is a long-tail counter that builds as you play: every choice you make in missions, dialogue and the open world adds up. You do not need to chase it deliberately; it accrues across a full playthrough. Keep playing and check the count here from time to time.
steps: Just play — choices in missions, dialogue and the open world all count.
Check the count here from time to time.
Reach 500 choices for the trophy.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This is one of the five hidden trophies whose exact condition is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists it as unknown. The name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something you failed once, so if you fail a challenge or activity, retry it at once rather than moving on. Treat it as a cleanup trophy for the final sweep.
steps: If you fail a challenge or activity, retry it immediately.
Succeed on the second attempt.
The trophy pops on the retry — check it in the final sweep (S7).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This is one of the five hidden trophies whose exact condition is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists it as unknown. The name points at something strange in the world, so keep your eyes open while exploring Leonida for an odd sight or event. Treat it as a cleanup trophy for the final sweep.
steps: Explore Leonida and watch for something strange.
Witness the odd event or sighting.
The trophy pops on the sighting — check it in the final sweep (S7).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon instead of a gun. It is a specific stunt, so set it up deliberately: get a vehicle moving, get close, and land the melee hit. PowerPyx lists its exact condition as still unconfirmed, so treat the description literally.
steps: Get a vehicle moving near a target.
Land a melee hit from the moving vehicle.
The trophy pops on the melee drive-by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies, so this trophy grows as you do the crime trophies — rob, collect the bills, and launder them through your contacts. The counter here moves in $25,000 steps, so ten taps is the full $250,000. It pairs naturally with the bank vaults and gang operations.
steps: Rob banks, trucks and operations to collect Marked Bills.
Launder the bills through your contacts.
Track the total here in $25,000 steps.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. This is the spending side of the money trophies — buy weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades until the total hits $100,000. It pairs with the laundering trophy: earn dirty money, clean it, then spend it. The counter here moves in $10,000 steps, so ten taps is the full $100,000.
steps: Buy weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades in shops.
Track the total here in $10,000 steps.
Reach $100,000 spent across all shops.
The trophy pops at $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought around Leonida and give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good and register for On the Spot. Buy them as you can afford them — the money from robberies and laundering covers the cost, so this trophy follows naturally from the crime set.
steps: Find the 8 garage properties for sale around Leonida.
Buy each one as you can afford it.
Tick each garage off here.
The trophy pops at 8 garages.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. This is the companion to discovering vehicles — once you find a vehicle you like, register it in the app so it is yours to call on. Ten registrations is the target, and it pairs with the 100 discovered for Whip It Good and the 8 garages for Little Boxes.
steps: Find vehicles around Leonida.
Register each one in the Scooter Bros app.
Tick each registration off here.
The trophy pops at 10 registered vehicles.
